 Skincare company Coiz wins China trademark challenge over goods in different classes
 By MLex Staff ( November 9, 2026, 07:41 GMT | Insight) -- South Korean skincare company Coiz has won a Chinese trademark challenge, with a court finding that goods in different trademark classes can be considered similar if consumers are likely to confuse their source.South Korean skincare company Coiz has won a Chinese trademark challenge, with a court finding that goods in different trademark classes can be considered similar if consumers are likely to confuse their source....
